comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Rate-regulated integrated electric and gas utility; no upstream gas production, unlike BKV's commodity-price-driven wellhead sales.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution and propane delivery; it buys gas rather than producing it from wells.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility; no upstream production or merchant-priced commodity sales.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Power generator selling electricity, which partly overlaps BKV's power segment. But it runs a coal plant and has no gas production or carbon capture.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Fee-based midstream gathering and processing in the Permian; it doesn't own the molecules or produce gas, so it differs from BKV's upstream business.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Compressor rental and fabrication, an oilfield equipment and services business, not a gas producer.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution utility with storage and solar; it doesn't produce gas from wells.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Small regulated local gas distribution utility; no production, power generation or carbon capture.
